claims.says: Applying any record list a well-formed replica accepts, then passing validate, leaves it well-formed: dead entities bare, relationship ids distinct, every relationship between live nodes.
The emitter's memoised grouping loop with its slot table, index and last-key shortcut yields exactly plain first-appearance grouping: same groups, order and members.
When the pending-change count is zero, the records the emitter would write are exactly its schema additions followed by its cancelled create/delete pair records.
If names are unique, a replica whose dictionary is the master's prefix accepts every name addition the master emits for the rest and ends with the master's dictionary.
Two label lists with the same members, in any order and with any duplicates, canonicalise to the same sorted key, so label order never splits a node shape.
